name: The Provision Broadcast
description: A cheerful, hour-long daily program produced by Axiom Workforce Solutions Content Group, structured around 'community updates,' lifestyle segments, and employee success stories. The show never acknowledges hardship directly — setbacks are reframed as 'growth events,' layoffs are 'resource rebalancing celebrations,' and all debt discussed is presented as a shared community investment. The host, Delwin Osei-Marchetti, has held the role for nineteen years without visibly aging, prompting persistent rumors about his contractual augmentation obligations.
cultural_impact: The phrase 'growth event' entered Meridian ironic vocabulary immediately, used to describe any catastrophic personal or civic failure.
story_hooks: Someone has been inserting single-frame subliminal corrections into the broadcast — true statistics replacing the show's curated figures — and Axiom's content security team can't find the insertion point.
Delwin Osei-Marchetti has privately requested extraction from his contract; his handler at Axiom has flagged the request as a 'loyalty concern.'
A Tier 1 community has been receiving The Provision Broadcast on a frequency they never subscribed to, and the version they're getting is subtly different from the licensed feed.
